description: A KPI tile: a large value with a caption, and — when the number is judged rather than just read — the comparison and the trend behind it. Compose inside a <Card> for a bordered surface, or use bare in a <Grid>. Copy: the label says what the number counts, with its unit and its period — "Invoices paid this quarter". The delta says what it is compared to, or it is not a comparison.

props.name: unit
props.description: Small suffix after the value, e.g. "/3" or "%".

props.name: delta
props.description: The comparison that makes the value mean something: "+12% vs last week".

props.name: deltaDirection
props.description: Which way it moved. Separate from `deltaTone` on purpose — up is good for revenue and bad for latency, so the arrow and the colour answer different questions. Named for the delta it describes, because `direction` alone was three different questions across the system (2026-08-26).

props.name: deltaTone
props.description: Whether that move is good news. Defaults to neutral, which colours nothing.

props.name: trend
props.description: The shape behind the number: pass a <Sparkline>.

example:
<Stat
  value="221"
  label="Sessions this week"
  delta="+9% vs last week"
  deltaDirection="up"
  deltaTone="success"
  trend={<Sparkline values={week} tone="success" size="sm" area />}
/>
